slides.text: Independent requests - Every request is self-contained - Every request is (considered) a fresh interaction @phrawzty // cerbos.dev 11
slides.original_description_html: Independent requests - Every request is self-contained - Every request is (considered) a fresh interaction @phrawzty // cerbos.dev 11

slides.text: Ex ternal state management - State is managed outside of the interaction - Client or external system manages continuity @phrawzty // cerbos.dev 12
slides.original_description_html: Ex ternal state management - State is managed outside of the interaction - Client or external system manages continuity @phrawzty // cerbos.dev 12

slides.text: Idempotency - Same request, same result - “referential transparency” @phrawzty // cerbos.dev 13
slides.original_description_html: Idempotency - Same request, same result - “referential transparency” @phrawzty // cerbos.dev 13

slides.text: Decoupled components - No shared state means forced modularity - Components communicate through interfaces @phrawzty // cerbos.dev 14
slides.original_description_html: Decoupled components - No shared state means forced modularity - Components communicate through interfaces @phrawzty // cerbos.dev 14

slides.text: Independent requests - Advantages: Resilient, flexible, and distributed - Disadvantages: Increased overhead, high network dependence @phrawzty // cerbos.dev 17
slides.original_description_html: Independent requests - Advantages: Resilient, flexible, and distributed - Disadvantages: Increased overhead, high network dependence @phrawzty // cerbos.dev 17

slides.text: Ex ternal state management - Advantages: Simplified server-side, straightforward scalability - Disadvantages: “Unusual” security profile, state synchronisation challenges @phrawzty // cerbos.dev 18
slides.original_description_html: Ex ternal state management - Advantages: Simplified server-side, straightforward scalability - Disadvantages: “Unusual” security profile, state synchronisation challenges @phrawzty // cerbos.dev 18

slides.text: Idempotency - Advantages: Improved reliability, graceful error recovery - Disadvantages: Reduced flexibility, potentially complex implementation @phrawzty // cerbos.dev 19
slides.original_description_html: Idempotency - Advantages: Improved reliability, graceful error recovery - Disadvantages: Reduced flexibility, potentially complex implementation @phrawzty // cerbos.dev 19

slides.text: Decoupled components - Advantages: Modular, flexible, fault-tolerant - Disadvantages: Coordination overhead, network intensive, sensitive to latency @phrawzty // cerbos.dev 20
slides.original_description_html: Decoupled components - Advantages: Modular, flexible, fault-tolerant - Disadvantages: Coordination overhead, network intensive, sensitive to latency @phrawzty // cerbos.dev 20

slides.text: Horizontal Scaling - Advantages: Elasticity, load distribution, resilience - Disadvantages: Now you’re managing a distributed system. My condolences. @phrawzty // cerbos.dev 21
